name: 6739-batchdecode-jamba52b-2gpu
hardware: 2x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, two GPUs of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1. TP=2 is forced -- 96.1 GiB of weights do not fit one 80 GB card.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=30, bounded at 150 requests / 1800 s safety, the first 20% warmup. Concurrency is part of the declaration, not a tunable.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, every request identical in shape: prompt exactly 1024 tokens, output exactly 256 tokens with `ignore_eos` so generation runs to full length. Sampling left at temperature 1.0.
purpose: A hybrid 52-billion-parameter assistant drafting fixed 256-token replies from 1024-token prompts for 30 concurrent users on two GPUs.
launch:
model: ai21labs/Jamba-v0.1

tensor-parallel-size: 2
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096

# HAZARD: BOTH OF THESE MUST STAY FALSE. `JambaForCausalLM.__init__` at this commit hard-asserts
# `not scheduler_config.chunked_prefill_enabled` and `not cache_config.enable_prefix_caching`,
# so an engine given either one raises at load. They already default off.
enable-chunked-prefill: false
enable-prefix-caching: false

enforce-eager: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0
